items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: they had more dancing girls and more big celebrities - such as Jean Harlow and that caliber of stars, you know

ctx.x: And, you would have made a lot of money too---
Well, I suppose I would have made at least $1,200 a week at that -- that's a hell of a lot of money. And, of course, then The Marks Brothers bought the

theaters - so, that changed everything. And, of course, as I said -- we were worried whether the Marks Brothers might dump us and put one of their own big bands in but they didn't because, as I said, we had the best theater stage band in all of Chicago. So, off we go to the Oriental-- and it was a fantastic theater, and it was such fun not to move around so much; of course, the shows were harder there. The shows were really bigger there; they had more dancing girls and more big celebrities - such as Jean Harlow…
